about: Level-lab boards (branch wip/level-variety, tools/lab) that Dennis played to a win in 2026-10-23/24, with his tries to the first win (restarts count as tries; an earlier unfinished start is not counted when its result was not recorded) and his stars/notes. Boards: tiles [x,y,z], faces, down, gold, obst {ice,locks,keys}, clock {i,n}, solution (a stored way through). A check for a human-like bot: it should need about as many tries, or fewer, than Dennis.

levels.title: Partners behind locks · brutal
levels.note: This felt impossible but in the end beatable. once you realise you have to take the keys first and then the alarm cause of tray space thats cool. And the very end how I finished I think I didnt need to make it as close to rely on the matching with one face down card. I just thought that it was the the best bet cause all other routes at the end felt like a dead end after calculating.
